# import data

```{r}
# R IFG inositol and NAA dataset

frontal_inositol_7T_IDs_demog_diag_metab_segment_baseline <- read_xlsx("path/to/frontal/inositol/dataset.xlsx")


frontal_NAA_7T_baseline_for_test <- read_xlsx("path/to/frontal/NAA/dataset.xlsx")

# inter ROI analysis dataset 

ROI_for_analysis_7T <- read_xlsx("path/to/inter-ROI/analysis.xlsx")

# MRS to blood dataset 

overlap_wbic_no_dupp_oneyear <- read_xlsx("path/to/mrs/blood/overlap/dataset.xlsx")

# MRS to cognition dataset 

ins_acer_analysis <- read_xlsx("path/to/inositol/cognition/dataset.xlsx")

controls_acer_full <- read_xlsx("path/to/controls/acer/dataset.xlsx")

```

# using frontal dataset - demographics  

```{r}
# numbers 

frontal_inositol_7T_IDs_demog_diag_metab_segment_baseline %>% 
  count(dia_05_dia)

# age 

frontal_inositol_7T_IDs_demog_diag_metab_segment_baseline %>% 
  group_by(dia_05_dia) %>% 
  get_summary_stats(age, type = "common")

frontal_inositol_7T_IDs_demog_diag_metab_segment_baseline %>% 
  t_test(age ~ diag_control_FTLD)

anova(lm(data = frontal_inositol_7T_IDs_demog_diag_metab_segment_baseline, age ~ dia_05_dia))
  
# sex

contingency_table <- frontal_inositol_7T_IDs_demog_diag_metab_segment_baseline %>%
  dplyr::select(sex, dia_05_dia) %>%
  table()

chi_square_result <- chisq.test(contingency_table)

chi_square_result

```


```{r}

# ACER

# get baseline ACER scores 
# 3 outliers where difference in imaging and clinical score > 1 year - to exclude

dat <- ins_acer_analysis %>% 
  filter(!id_charmed %in% c(2871,2831,599)) %>% 
  dplyr::select(-id_charmed, -wbic, -p00_dir, -session_date, - visits_clin_date, -acer_39_memtot, -acer_40_fluentot, -acer_41_langtot, -acer_42_visuosptot, -diag_FTLD, -imaging_clinscore_difftime_abs, - ins_atrophy_resid) %>% 
  mutate(diagnosis = as.factor(diagnosis),
         sex = as.factor(sex))
  
tempData <- mice(dat,m=20,maxit=20,meth='pmm',seed=500)

# extract the imputed acer total and attention subscore 

imp_vals_acer_total<-sapply(complete(tempData, "all"),
                   function(d) d$acer_37_acertot)

imp_vals_acer_atten<-sapply(complete(tempData, "all"),
                   function(d) d$acer_38_atttot)

imp_vals_educ<-sapply(complete(tempData, "all"),
                   function(d) d$years_of_education)

imp_vals_difftime<-sapply(complete(tempData, "all"),
                   function(d) d$imaging_clinscore_difftime)

# 2) Row-wise mean across imputations
imp_mean_acer <- rowMeans(imp_vals_acer_total)
imp_mean_attn <- rowMeans(imp_vals_acer_atten)
imp_mean_educ <- rowMeans(imp_vals_educ)
imp_mean_difftime <- rowMeans(imp_vals_difftime)

# 3) Replace NAs in original data in new imputed filled dataset

ins_acer_analysis_imputed <- ins_acer_analysis

ins_acer_analysis_imputed$acer_37_acertot[ is.na(ins_acer_analysis_imputed$acer_37_acertot)] <- imp_mean_acer[is.na(ins_acer_analysis_imputed$acer_37_acertot)]

ins_acer_analysis_imputed$acer_38_atttot[ is.na(ins_acer_analysis_imputed$acer_38_atttot)] <- imp_mean_attn[is.na(ins_acer_analysis_imputed$acer_38_atttot)]

ins_acer_analysis_imputed$years_of_education[ is.na(ins_acer_analysis_imputed$years_of_education)] <- imp_mean_educ[is.na(ins_acer_analysis_imputed$years_of_education)]

ins_acer_analysis_imputed$imaging_clinscore_difftime[ is.na(ins_acer_analysis_imputed$imaging_clinscore_difftime)] <- imp_mean_difftime[is.na(ins_acer_analysis_imputed$imaging_clinscore_difftime)]

# get baseline and remove the same 3 outliers as above 

baseline_acer_imputed <- ins_acer_analysis_imputed %>% 
  group_by(id_charmed) %>% 
  slice_min(imaging_clinscore_difftime_abs, n = 1)

baseline_acer_imputed_no_outliers<- baseline_acer_imputed %>% 
  filter(!id_charmed %in% c(2871,2831,599)) |> 
  ungroup()

# check group differences 

acer_demographic_set <- 
  bind_rows(
    controls_acer_full %>% ungroup() %>% dplyr::select(id_charmed,acer_37_acertot) %>% mutate(diagnosis = rep("Control", nrow(controls_acer_full))),
    baseline_acer_imputed_no_outliers %>% ungroup() %>% dplyr::select(id_charmed, acer_37_acertot,diagnosis)
  ) %>% 
  mutate(diag_control_FTLD = if_else(diagnosis == "Control", "Control", "FTLD"))

acer_demographic_set %>% 
  group_by(diag_control_FTLD) %>% 
  get_summary_stats(acer_37_acertot, type = "common")

acer_demographic_set %>% 
  group_by(diagnosis) %>% 
  get_summary_stats(acer_37_acertot, type = "common")


acer_demographic_set %>% 
  t_test(acer_37_acertot ~ diag_control_FTLD)

anova(lm(data = acer_demographic_set, acer_37_acertot ~ diagnosis))

tukey_hsd(lm(data = acer_demographic_set, acer_37_acertot ~ diagnosis))

```




# using ROI dataset - for inter regional (R IFG, R OCC) WM GM fraction 

```{r}

# numbers of diagnosis for current ROI set

ROI_for_analysis_7T %>% 
  filter(ROI == "R_IFG") %>% 
  count(dia_05_dia)

```


```{r}

# differences in WM and GM fraction 

model_atrophy <- lmer( WM_GM_frac ~ age  + sex +  diag_control_FTLD * ROI + (1 | subject) , data = ROI_for_analysis_7T )

emmeans(model_atrophy, pairwise ~ diag_control_FTLD | ROI, adjust = "tukey") # getting estimate marginal means, and differences within ROI

summary(model_atrophy) # to get p value with R IFG as reference region

roi_differences <- emmeans(model_atrophy, ~ diag_control_FTLD * ROI) # to get difference in regional differences

res <- contrast(roi_differences,
         method = list(c(-1,1, 1,-1)),  # (FTLD R IFG - Controls  R IFG) - (FTLD R OCC - Controls R OCC)
         adjust = "tukey")

s <- summary(res)

s$p.value


# subgroup atrophy models 

model_atrophy_subgroup <- lmer( WM_GM_frac ~ age  + sex +  diagnosis * ROI + (1 | subject) , data = ROI_for_analysis_7T )

res_atrophy_subgroup <- emmeans(model_atrophy_subgroup, pairwise ~ diagnosis | ROI, adjust = "tukey")

res_atrophy_subgroup_df <- as.data.frame(res_atrophy_subgroup$contrasts)

```



```{r}

# boxplots for WM GM fraction 

# boxplots of WM_GM_frac in ROIs by diagnosis of FTLD vs Controls - sup fig 1

ROI_for_analysis_7T %>%  
  mutate(diag_control_FTLD = relevel(as.factor(diag_control_FTLD),"Control")) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = ROI, y = WM_GM_frac, fill = diag_control_FTLD)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.4,
               position = position_dodge(width = 1.0)) +
  geom_point(
    aes(color = diag_control_FTLD),
    alpha = 0.7,
    position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.2, dodge.width = 1.0)
  ) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 0.8, xend = 1.2, y = 0.98, yend = 0.98)) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 1.8, xend = 2.2, y = 0.98, yend = 0.98)) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 1.0, xend = 2.0, y = 1.05, yend = 1.05 )) +
  annotate("text", x = 1, y = 1.0, label = " *** ") +
  annotate("text", x = 2, y = 1.0, label = " * ") +
  annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = 1.06, label = " *** ") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Control" = "#F8766D", "FTLD" = "#00BFC4")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Control" = "#F8766D", "FTLD" = "#00BFC4")) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = c("R_IFG" = "Right IFG",
                              "R_OCC" = "Right OCC")) +
  ylab("Fraction of brain tissue in voxel") + 
  xlab("Region") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 14)
  )


# boxplots of WM_GM_frac in ROIs by subgroups - sup fig 2 

ROI_for_analysis_7T %>%  
  filter(ROI == "R_IFG") %>% 
  mutate(diagnosis = relevel(as.factor(diagnosis),"Control")) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = diagnosis, y = WM_GM_frac, fill = diagnosis)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.4,
               position = position_dodge(width = 1.0)) +
  geom_point(
    aes(color = diagnosis),
    alpha = 0.7,
    position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.2, dodge.width = 1.0)
  ) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 1.0, xend = 2.0, y = 0.99, yend = 0.99)) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 1.0, xend = 3.0, y = 1.05, yend = 1.05)) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 2.0, xend = 3.0, y = 0.95, yend = 0.95)) +
  annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = 1.01, size = 3 , label = " *** ") +
  annotate("text", x = 2.0, y = 1.07, size = 3 , label = " *** ") + 
  annotate("text", x = 2.5, y = 0.97, size = 3 , label = " *** ") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Control" = "#F8766D", "bvFTD" = "#00BFC4","PSP" = "#00BA38" )) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Control" = "#F8766D", "bvFTD" = "#00BFC4", "PSP" = "#00BA38")) +
  theme_classic() +
  ylab("Fraction of brain tissue in Right IFG voxel") + 
  xlab("Diagnosis") +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank(),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
        axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 14),
        axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 14))

```

# using ROI dataset - for inter regional (R IFG, R OCC) myo-inositol

```{r}
# regional differences in myo-inositol

# transform mmol/kg into log

ROI_for_analysis_7T <- ROI_for_analysis_7T %>% 
  mutate(log_mmolkg = log2(mMol.kg)) %>% 
  relocate(log_mmolkg, .before = mMol.kg )


# getting SNR and FWHM by diagnostic group FTLD vs control - R IFG

ROI_for_analysis_7T %>% ungroup() %>% 
  filter(ROI == "R_IFG") %>% 
  group_by(diag_control_FTLD) %>%
  get_summary_stats(SNR, FWHM, mMol.kg_CRLB, log_mmolkg, type = "common") %>%
  dplyr::select(diag_control_FTLD, variable, median, mean, iqr, sd)

t_test(ROI_for_analysis_7T %>% filter(ROI == "R_IFG"), SNR ~ diag_control_FTLD)
t_test(ROI_for_analysis_7T %>% filter(ROI == "R_IFG"), FWHM ~ diag_control_FTLD)
t_test(ROI_for_analysis_7T %>% filter(ROI == "R_IFG"), mMol.kg_CRLB ~ diag_control_FTLD)


# getting SNR and FWHM by diagnostic group FTLD vs control - R 0CC

ROI_for_analysis_7T %>% ungroup() %>% 
  filter(ROI == "R_OCC") %>% 
  group_by(diag_control_FTLD) %>%
  get_summary_stats(SNR, FWHM, mMol.kg_CRLB, log_mmolkg, type = "common") %>%
  dplyr::select(diag_control_FTLD, variable, median, mean, iqr, sd)

t_test(ROI_for_analysis_7T %>% filter(ROI == "R_OCC"), SNR ~ diag_control_FTLD)
t_test(ROI_for_analysis_7T %>% filter(ROI == "R_OCC"), FWHM ~ diag_control_FTLD)
t_test(ROI_for_analysis_7T %>% filter(ROI == "R_OCC"), mMol.kg_CRLB ~ diag_control_FTLD)

# regional differences FTLD vs controls 

model_inositol <- lmer( log_mmolkg ~ age  + sex +  diag_control_FTLD * ROI + (1 | subject), data = ROI_for_analysis_7T )

summary(model_inositol)

emmeans(model_inositol, pairwise ~ diag_control_FTLD | ROI, adjust = "tukey")

roi_differences <- emmeans(model_inositol, ~ diag_control_FTLD * ROI)

res_inositol_roi_diff <- contrast(roi_differences,
         method = list(c(-1,1, 1,-1)),  # (FTLD IFG - Controls IFG) - (FTLD OCC - Controls OCC)
         adjust = "tukey")

s_inositol_roi_diff <- summary(res_inositol_roi_diff)

s_inositol_roi_diff$p.value

# subgroup differences 

model_inositol_subgroup <- lmer( log_mmolkg ~ age  + sex +  dia_05_dia * ROI + (1 | subject) , data = ROI_for_analysis_7T )

res_inositol_subgroup <- emmeans(model_inositol_subgroup, pairwise ~ dia_05_dia | ROI, adjust = "tukey")

res_inositol_subgroup_df <- as.data.frame(res_inositol_subgroup$contrasts)

```

```{r}
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Control" = "#F8766D", "bvFTD" = "#00BFC4","PSP" = "#00BA38" )) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Control" = "#F8766D", "bvFTD" = "#00BFC4", "PSP" = "#00BA38")) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 1.0, xend = 2.0, y = 4.5, yend = 4.5)) +
  annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = 4.55, label = " *** ", size = 4) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 1.0, xend = 3.0, y = 4.65, yend = 4.65)) +
  annotate("text", x = 2.0, y = 4.70, label = " n.s ", size = 4) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 2.0, xend = 3.0, y = 4.55, yend = 4.55)) +
   annotate("text", x = 2.5, y = 4.60, label = " *** ", size = 4) +
  ylab("NAA ( log2 mmol/kg )") + 
  xlab("Diagnosis") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank(),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
        axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 14),
        axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 14))
```

```{r}
  "TREM1",
  "TREM2",
  "VCAM1"
)

#  selecting immune markers
overlap_wbic_no_dupp_oneyear_inflam <- 
  overlap_wbic_no_dupp_oneyear %>% 
  dplyr::select(id_charmed, study_ID, wbic, diagnosis, age, sex, subject_mod, study_date, session_date, mMol.kg,blood_image_timediff_yrs_abs, WM_GM_frac, p00_dir, all_of(immune_markers), NEFL) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(diag_FTLD = if_else(diagnosis == "Control", "Control", "FTLD"))

# log transform then z score

overlap_wbic_no_dupp_oneyear_inflam_log_z <- 
  overlap_wbic_no_dupp_oneyear_inflam %>% 
  mutate(across(c(mMol.kg), ~ log2(.))) %>% 
  mutate(across(c(mMol.kg,CCL11:NEFL ), ~ as.numeric(scale(.))))

# now allow for a non absolute diff time (session - study), and also combining p00 dir 

overlap_wbic_no_dupp_oneyear_inflam_log_z <- overlap_wbic_no_dupp_oneyear_inflam_log_z %>% 
   mutate(blood_image_timediff_yrs = as.numeric(difftime(session_date, study_date, units = "days") / 365.25))

```



```{r}

# remove batch effects with combat from blood markers

blood_markers <- overlap_wbic_no_dupp_oneyear_inflam_log_z %>% dplyr::select(CCL11:NEFL)
batch <- as.factor(overlap_wbic_no_dupp_oneyear_inflam_log_z$study_ID)    
dat <- t(blood_markers) 
mod <- model.matrix(~ age + sex + diagnosis + mMol.kg + blood_image_timediff_yrs + WM_GM_frac, data = overlap_wbic_no_dupp_oneyear_inflam_log_z %>% dplyr::select(-id_charmed, -diag_FTLD, -wbic, -subject_mod ))

combat_corrected <- ComBat(
  dat = dat,
  batch = batch,
  mod = mod,
  par.prior = TRUE,     # use empirical Bayes
  prior.plots = FALSE   # set TRUE to see diagnostic plots
)

corrected_df <- t(combat_corrected)

# combine combat corrected blood measures with dataset 

combat_corrected_df <- data.frame(corrected_df)

for_join <- overlap_wbic_no_dupp_oneyear_inflam_log_z %>% 
  dplyr::select(-c(CCL11:NEFL)) 
  
overlap_wbic_no_dupp_oneyear_inflam_log_z_combat_corrected <- bind_cols(for_join,combat_corrected_df)

overlap_wbic_no_dupp_oneyear_inflam_log_z_combat_corrected$mMol.kg <- as.numeric(overlap_wbic_no_dupp_oneyear_inflam_log_z_combat_corrected$mMol.kg)

```


```{r}
# assessing blood to image time difference 

overlap_wbic_no_dupp_oneyear_inflam_log_z_combat_corrected |> 
  group_by(diag_FTLD) |> 
  get_summary_stats(blood_image_timediff_yrs, type = "common")

overlap_wbic_no_dupp_oneyear_inflam_log_z_combat_corrected |> 
  t_test(blood_image_timediff_yrs ~ diag_FTLD)

```


```{r}
# PLS of inositol to blood 

# pls analysis

library(pls)

for_pls <- overlap_wbic_no_dupp_oneyear_inflam_log_z_combat_corrected %>% dplyr::select(mMol.kg, CCL11:VCAM1)

pls_inflam_blood <- 
 plsr( mMol.kg ~ . ,
  data = for_pls,
  scale = FALSE,        # already z-scored 
)

# check amount of variance explained by the pls components in inositol 

R2obj <- R2(pls_inflam_blood, estimate = "train")

vec <- numeric(53)

for (i in 1:53) {
  vec[i] <- R2obj$val[i]
}

vec <- vec[-1]

var_inos_pls_comps <- data_frame(variance_explained_inositol = vec * 100, 
           component = seq_len(length(vec)))


# validation of the first 2 PLS components - method 1 using Q2Y metric in ropls, LOOCV, 10000 permutations 

X <- for_pls %>% dplyr::select(-mMol.kg) %>% as.matrix()
y <- as.numeric(for_pls$mMol.kg)

set.seed(2026)
opls_inflam <- opls(
  x         = X,
  y         = y,
  predI     = 2,        # 2 predictive components to match plsr model
  orthoI    = 0,        # 0 = plain PLS (not OPLS)
  scaleC    = "center", # markers already z-scored, so just centre
  crossvalI = nrow(X),  # number of CV segments = n, i.e. leave-one-out
  permI     = 10000,    # permutations; each one refits the model
  fig.pdfC  = "none"
)

getSummaryDF(opls_inflam)   # R2X(cum), R2Y(cum), Q2(cum), RMSEE, pR2Y, pQ2
plot(opls_inflam, typeVc = "permutation")

# validation of the first 2 PLS components - method 2 using non-parametric bootstrapping, 50 runs of 500 bootstrap replicates 

X <- as.matrix(dplyr::select(for_pls, -mMol.kg))
Y <- for_pls$mMol.kg

set.seed(500)

K_hat <- nbcomp.bootplsR(
  Y = Y,
  X = X,
  R = 500,          # number of bootstrap replicates
  verbose = FALSE
)

K_hat

set.seed(500)

K_rep <- replicate(
  50,
  nbcomp.bootplsR(Y = Y, X = X, R = 500, verbose = FALSE)
)

table(K_rep)
barplot(table(K_rep), xlab = "Selected #components", ylab = "Count")

```



```{r}
# extract and display PLS loadings of component 1 and 2 - figure 3

pls_loadings <- data.frame(
  pls_comp1_loadings = pls_inflam_blood$loadings[ , 1],
  pls_comp2_loadings = pls_inflam_blood$loadings[ , 2]
)

pls_loadings$biomarker <- rownames(pls_loadings)

pls_loadings_long <- pls_loadings %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("pls_comp"),
    names_to = "component",
    values_to = "loading"
  )

max_abs_loading <- max(abs(pls_loadings_long$loading), na.rm = TRUE)

pls_1 <- pls_loadings_long %>% 
  filter(component == "pls_comp1_loadings")

pls_1_loadings <- pls_1 %>%
  mutate(
    biomarker = reorder(biomarker, loading)
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x = component,
    y = biomarker,
    fill = loading
  )) +
  geom_tile() +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = round(loading, 2)),
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "blue",
    mid = "white",
    high = "red",
    midpoint = 0,
    limits = c(-max_abs_loading, max_abs_loading)
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c(
    "pls_comp1_loadings" = "Component 1"
  )) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12)) +
  labs(
    y = "Inflammatory marker",
    fill = "Loading",
    x = NULL
  )

pls_2 <- pls_loadings_long %>% 
  filter(component == "pls_comp2_loadings")

pls_2_loadings <- pls_2 %>% 
  mutate(
    biomarker = reorder(biomarker, loading)
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x = component,
    y = biomarker,
    fill = loading
  )) +
  geom_tile() +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = round(loading, 2)),
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "blue",
    mid = "white",
    high = "red",
    midpoint = 0,
    limits = c(-max_abs_loading, max_abs_loading)
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c(
    "pls_comp2_loadings" = "Component 2"
  )) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12)) +
  labs(
    y = "Inflammatory marker",
    fill = "Loading",
    x = NULL
  )

pls_loadings_plot <- (pls_1_loadings | pls_2_loadings) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A")
```

# PLS components 2nd level analysis 

```{r}
# extracting PLS componet scores for second level analysis 

# extract the components to use 

for_join_components <- overlap_wbic_no_dupp_oneyear_inflam_log_z_combat_corrected %>% 
  dplyr::select(id_charmed, study_ID, wbic, diagnosis, diag_FTLD, age, sex, subject_mod, mMol.kg, blood_image_timediff_yrs, blood_image_timediff_yrs_abs, WM_GM_frac, p00_dir, NEFL, GFAP, -c(CCL11:GDF15,ICAM1:VCAM1))

demog_pls_components <- for_join_components %>% 
  mutate(pls_comp1 = pls_inflam_blood$scores[ , 1],
         pls_comp2 = pls_inflam_blood$scores[ , 2],
         pls_comp3 = pls_inflam_blood$scores[ , 3]) %>% 
  mutate(diag_FTLD = relevel(factor(diag_FTLD), ref = "FTLD"))

# group differences in comp 1 

t.test(data = demog_pls_components, pls_comp1 ~ diag_FTLD)

# linear relationship between comp 1 and inositol 

lm_plscomp1_ins <- lm(mMol.kg ~ diag_FTLD * pls_comp1 + age + sex + blood_image_timediff_yrs , data = demog_pls_components)

summary(lm_plscomp1_ins)

slopes_plscomp1 <- emtrends(
  lm_plscomp1_ins,
  ~ diag_FTLD,
  var = "pls_comp1"
)

pairs(slopes_plscomp1)

# group differences in component 2 

t.test(data = demog_pls_components, pls_comp2 ~ diag_FTLD)

subgroup_pls2 <- lm(data = demog_pls_components, pls_comp2 ~ diagnosis)

anova(subgroup_pls2)

tukey_hsd(subgroup_pls2)

# linear relationships PLS comp 2 

lm_plscomp2_ins <- lm(mMol.kg ~ diag_FTLD * pls_comp2 + age + sex + blood_image_timediff_yrs, data = demog_pls_components |> 
                        mutate(diag_FTLD = relevel(diag_FTLD, "Control")))

summary(lm_plscomp2_ins)

slopes_plscomp2 <- emtrends(
  lm_plscomp2_ins,
  ~ diag_FTLD,
  var = "pls_comp2"
)

slopes_plscomp2

pairs(slopes_plscomp2)

# subgroup linear relationships PLS comp 2

lm_plscomp2_ins_subgroups <- lm(mMol.kg ~ diagnosis * pls_comp2 + age + sex + blood_image_timediff_yrs , data = demog_pls_components |> 
                                  mutate(diagnosis = relevel(as.factor(diagnosis), "PSP")))

summary(lm_plscomp2_ins_subgroups)

anova(lm_plscomp2_ins_subgroups)

slopes <- emtrends(
  lm_plscomp2_ins_subgroups,
  ~ diagnosis,
  var = "pls_comp2"
)

slopes

pairs(slopes)

```

```{r}
  annotate("text", x = -3 , y = 2.6, label = "FTLD: β = 0.32, p = 0.02 *", size = 4) +
  theme_classic () +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank(),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),
        axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 14),
        axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 14))


ggplot(demog_pls_components, aes(x = pls_comp2, y = GFAP, color = diagnosis)) + 
  geom_point()  + 
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE , alpha = 0.15) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Control" = "#F8766D", "bvFTD" = "#00BFC4","PSP" = "#00BA38" )) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Control" = "#F8766D", "bvFTD" = "#00BFC4", "PSP" = "#00BA38")) +
  ylab("GFAP (z-scored)") + 
  xlab("PLS component 2 scores") +
  annotate("text", x = -2.5 , y = 2.2, label = "Controls: β = 0.02, p = 0.94", size = 4) +
  annotate("text", x = -2.5 , y = 2.6, label = "PSP: β = 0.29, p = 0.31", size = 4) +
  annotate("text", x = -2.5 , y = 3.0, label = "bvFTD: β = 0.21, p = 0.19", size = 4) +
  theme_classic () +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank(),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),
        axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 14),
        axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 14))

```






# ACER to mI analysis 

```{r}
# full ACER score all patients

lm_acer_imputed <- lm(acer_37_acertot ~ log_mmolkg + age + sex + years_of_education + diagnosis + imaging_clinscore_difftime, data = baseline_acer_imputed_no_outliers)

summary(lm_acer_imputed)

# full ACER score interaction

lm_acer_imputed_subgroups <- lm(acer_37_acertot ~ diagnosis*log_mmolkg + age + sex + years_of_education + imaging_clinscore_difftime, data = baseline_acer_imputed_no_outliers)

summary(lm_acer_imputed_subgroups)

# ACER attention and orientation subscore all patients

lm_acer_imputed_attn <- lm(acer_38_atttot ~ log_mmolkg + age + sex + years_of_education + diagnosis + imaging_clinscore_difftime  , data = baseline_acer_imputed_no_outliers )

summary(lm_acer_imputed_attn)

# ACER attention and orientation subscore interaction

lm_acer_imputed_attn_subgroup <- lm(acer_38_atttot ~ diagnosis*log_mmolkg + age + sex + years_of_education + imaging_clinscore_difftime , data = baseline_acer_imputed_no_outliers)

summary(lm_acer_imputed_attn_subgroup)
```
